collision.self_collision_note: DETECTED, not PREVENTED: the airframe is loaded without URDF_USE_SELF_COLLISION, so the solver will not push the arm out of the body. getClosestPoints is used, which reports penetration regardless of that flag.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: Sensor frames aimed 90 deg off the nose
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: Every sensor frame in the environment package and in the URDF was built with rpy = (90 - pitch, 0, yaw), which maps the optical -Z onto body +Y. A 'forward-looking' camera pointed out the left side. The exported REV-B manifest recorded the contradiction as optical_axis_world = [0, 1, 0] on a sensor with zero mount angles.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Base optical rotation corrected to rpy = (90, 0, -90); mount pitch and yaw applied in the body frame outside it. Fixed in both avian/description/build_urdf.py and avian_env/sensors.py, and the REV-B sensor manifest regenerated.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: Found by S14. T10 now asserts every boresight against its mount angles, so this class of error fails a test instead of surviving.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: LiDAR and IMU were given camera frames
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: A spinning LiDAR sweeps azimuth about its own +Z. With an optical frame its spin axis lay horizontal and the scan plane came out vertical. An IMU must report in the body frame by definition.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Those two frames are now body-aligned, declared explicitly as frame_convention = 'body' rather than left to be inferred.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: T10 asserts the LiDAR spin axis is body +Z.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: Self-collision checking was vacuous
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: The airframe is loaded without URDF_USE_SELF_COLLISION, so getContactPoints(body, body) returns an empty list for every pose. check_self_collision() and T09 therefore reported 'clear' for a pose with link_5 buried 112 mm inside the fuselage.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Both now use getClosestPoints, which reports geometric penetration regardless of that flag, and exclude parent-child pairs by the real URDF parent relation instead of an index heuristic.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: M25 asserts both directions: clear when clear, DETECTED when not. Self-collision is detected, not prevented -- see Limitations.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: solve_ik measured the CAD cross-check from the wrong frame
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: getBasePositionAndOrientation returns the centre-of-mass frame. base_link's inertial origin is 86 mm off its URDF origin, so the CAD-vs-simulation agreement check was 86 mm out and rejected every correct solution it found. IK solved 0 of 12 reachable targets.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Added Manipulator.base_frame(), which removes the inertial offset. IK now solves 12 of 12 to a worst error of 0.2 mm.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: M24 asserts >= 9/12 solved to <= 10 mm AND that a 3 m target is refused.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: Depth camera reported its own airframe as an obstacle
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: The depth sensor sits 200 mm forward on a vehicle with 575 mm arms, and the camera origin sat inside the fuselage shell: 46 % of the frame was own structure and the nearest return was 0.09 m.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Segmentation self-mask, with the background test done before the bit-mask so -1 cannot alias onto a body id. With the frame orientation also corrected, self-masked pixels fell from 46 % to 0.2 %.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: S14 compares the range at the principal point against a ray cast along the same boresight.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: Rate gate muted a sensor after a clock rewind
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: The gate accumulates phase in _next_due. Clearing last_stamp alone left a previously-read sensor silent for a whole simulated second.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Added Sensor.reset_timing(), which re-anchors the gate. A mission leg or a replay needs the same call.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: S18 measures 200 samples in 1 s at 200 Hz.

defects_found_and_fixed.title: S14 compared the camera against geometry it could not see
defects_found_and_fixed.what_was_wrong: The original test compared the depth camera's whole-frame minimum against min_clearance(), which is the distance to the nearest structure ANYWHERE in 3-D -- under the deck, that is the soffit above the aircraft, outside a forward-looking camera's field of view. The test was invalid, not merely failing.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Rewritten to park the aircraft a fixed stand-off from a river pier and compare the boresight range against a ray cast along the same axis. The 0.6 m tolerance was NOT relaxed.
defects_found_and_fixed.now_tested_by: This was a test defect and is recorded as one.

limitations.title: Self-collision is detected, not prevented
limitations.detail: URDF_USE_SELF_COLLISION is off, because enabling contact response between links of one body changes flight dynamics that are already validated. The solver will not push the arm out of the airframe; planning must not command a pose check_self_collision() rejects.

limitations.title: Link inertia is a point-mass aggregation
limitations.detail: Mass and centre of gravity come exactly from the 389-row budget; the inertia tensor is approximate. Recorded as inertia_method in the generated manifest.

limitations.title: Manipulator acceleration limits are estimated
limitations.detail: The CAD gives torque and speed but no acceleration limit. a = tau / I with I from downstream link masses is a lower bound on inertia and so an optimistic acceleration. Used for trajectory timing only, never for a safety decision.

limitations.title: Camera rendering is CPU-bound and that shapes the architecture
limitations.detail: 640x480 costs about 300 ms/frame on this host and 1920x1080 about 1.8 s. Cameras are waypoint-triggered rather than free-running because of the hardware, and the policy is recorded rather than hidden.

limitations.title: The GNSS datum is arbitrary
limitations.detail: No real site is claimed. Quality degradation is computed by casting rays at the sky, not looked up from a table.

limitations.title: The arm is validated with the airframe held
limitations.detail: Whether the aircraft holds station against the reaction of a moving 6-DOF arm is a flight-dynamics question. It is not answered in Phase 1 and is not implied by these results.
